drives: none - local deterministic linter over the plugin's apps/ card specs and schemas/
validation_layers: dependency-free structural floor (always) + jsonschema full validation with a registry over schemas/ (when present); RVND_LINT_NO_JSONSCHEMA=1 forces the floor-only path
enforces: a composition rendering 'proposal' must also render 'patch' and 'receipt'
forbids_scores and attributed must be true (discrete lamps, attributed-not-asserted)
every composition is fail_closed and drives the rvnd server

a proposal carries a residual ledger, records its language version, and its constructs are structurally typed and restricted to the real 0.8.2 vocabulary (node classes, cord types, guard domain kind/risk/party/tags)
well_formed:false is never applyable; validation must state applyable explicitly
canonical_observation validates against the official observation object; a delta's construct is structurally typed with additionalProperties:false
card selection follows present construct types; a residual panel shows whenever residual exists
provenance: Authored for loomground; validates RVND surface and proposal specs against the plugin schemas. No third-party skill source.
notes: Progressive-disclosure: lean SKILL.md + references/ pair + shared plugin references. Uses optional jsonschema when present; plain checks always run.
review: Validated against the declared compatible RVND release range.
